correctness.rationale: At a state with c clique and l periphery ones, total s=c+l, clique updates all 0 or all 1 depending on 2s<N or >N, and complements precisely at 2s=N; periphery updates 0, unchanged or 1 according to 2c<a,=a,>a. For recurrent mixed clique, total balance forces complementary clique each step. Its independent part is fixed if a,b both even and c=a/2,l=b/2 (H) or switches all-zero/all-one for a>b matching parity (J). Monochromatic clique yields two consensus fixed and the anti-aligned 2-cycle iff b>=a. The balanced/unbalanced case split proves all states enter 2-cycles within 3 rounds, sharp iff an integer c lies strictly between (a-b)/2 and a/2. Direct graph-neighbor bit-level enumeration verified 71 eligible parameter pairs a+b<=14.
